description: React component for user profile 'About' section, allowing editing of name, location, picture, and about info with validation and state management.

methods.name: ShowImageValidationWarning
methods.description: Component displaying an alert when image URL validation fails.

methods.name: checkIfValidImage
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if an image URL is valid by attempting to load it.

methods.name: isFormPristine
methods.description: Determines if the form has unsaved changes or invalid image URL.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, triggers save if form is valid and changed.

methods.name: handlePictureChange
methods.description: Validates and updates picture URL in form state.

methods.name: handleAboutChange
methods.description: Updates about text in form state.
